effectiveModel: Uniform deterministic bit algorithm with worst-case running time.
qualifications: The exponent h(p) is finite and nonnegative. There is a computable function T such that h(p) ≤ max(1, p log₂(max(2, p)))/j for every positive integer j and every p ≥ T(j).

reader.label: Effective little-o bound in the supplied path width

statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides Vertex-Disjoint Paths within the stated running time.
